title: She grew up in a Telangana village. In September 2026, she became mayor of an Australian city.

sources.text: Telangana Today - Telangana native Sandy Reddy elected Strathfield Mayor in Australia
NewKerala - Telangana CM congratulates Sandhya Reddy becoming mayor Strathfield

caption:
She grew up in a Telangana village. In September 2026, she became mayor of an Australian city.

Born in Telangana, India, she moved to Australia in 1991 after completing her education at Stanley College and Osmania University in Hyderabad. She now works as a migration and education consultant.

Among the first Indian-origin mayors elected in Australia, her path shows how local government representation for Indian-origin leaders abroad is being built from the ground up, not handed down.

Reddy's path from a Telangana village to a Sydney mayor's office is a reminder that Indian-origin success abroad increasingly shows up in municipal government, close to where people actually live.
